edits.old_string: On the ruling it lands at once on its own branch, its diff operator-approved, through `crucible:finishing-a-development-branch`.
edits.new_string: The ruling also decides whether it takes a campaign (umbrellas.md § Review); on the ruling, or after that campaign, it lands at once on its own branch, its diff operator-approved, through `crucible:finishing-a-development-branch`.

note: Binding-change paragraph: the ruling now also decides whether the change takes a campaign (umbrellas.md § Review), and landing follows the ruling or that campaign.
